# AS2.py
*`src/pySEA/rayTEM/AS2.py`*

## Overview

`AS2.py` provides a minimal HTTP client for the Nion AS2 control server. It is used by the `microscopes/` scripts to read live lens excitations and push new values when fitting calibrations against a running instrument.

This module is independent of the rayTEM optics framework — it does not import `elements`, `assemblies`, or `seashells`. It is purely a transport utility.

---

## AS2querier

A thin wrapper around `requests` that talks to the AS2 REST API at `http://<ip>:<port>/AS2/controls/<element_name>`.

### `AS2querier.__init__(self, ip, port, quiet)`

Stores `self.url = "http://<ip>:<port>/AS2/controls/"` and `self.quiet` flag. Does not connect or verify availability at construction time.

- `quiet=True` suppresses all print output (useful in batch scripts where console noise is unwanted).

### `AS2querier.query(self, element_name)`

Issues a GET request to `self.url + element_name` and returns the `"OutputValue"` field from the JSON response.

On any connection failure the call sleeps 50 ms and returns `np.random.random()` — a fallback that lets scripts continue running in offline/development contexts without crashing. If `quiet=False` the exception and a warning are printed.

On a non-200 HTTP status, prints a warning (unless quiet) and also returns a random value.

On success, prints `"queried: <element_name> = <value>"` (unless quiet) and returns the float value.

### `AS2querier.setLens(self, element_name, value, scaling)`

Issues a PUT request to set `<element_name>` to `value * scaling`. Default `scaling=1e-6` converts microradian or microampere values (as typically stored in calibration scripts) to the SI units expected by AS2. Errors are printed but not raised.
